skill.summary: Get script-based videos ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your written script (TXT, DOCX, PDF, plain text, up to 500MB), say something...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Generator from Script.

- Instantly generate 1080p MP4 videos from TXT, DOCX, PDF, or plain text scripts (up to 500MB).
- Automatic voiceover and matching visuals; no manual editing or filming needed.
- Easy workflow: upload your script, give instructions (e.g., "turn my script into a video"), and download when ready.
- Designed for marketers, content creators, and educators seeking fast, shareable videos.
- Includes free anonymous access with 100 credits (7-day token), session management, and robust error handling.
- Supports export, credits check, timeline previews, and iterative editing within a cloud-powered environment.
